sonnet.problem: The card asks what God is offering when He says 'Open wide your mouth, and I will fill it,' and the right answer ('To give them what they need') says what the picture stands for. Verse 10 never says so. The only link to feeding comes later in verse 16, and the baker hasn't seen that yet. Because of this, the baker has to guess what the picture means rather than reason it out from the text.
sonnet.rule: He retells the picture as the text gives it and says what it stands for only when the passage says so.
